projectDescription: A mobile-style event tracker app for quickly adding, viewing, and managing important dates — available as a native Android app and a browser-based demo.
keyFeatures: User account creation and login (local SQLite on Android, localStorage in browser)
Upcoming events dashboard with two-column card layout
Add, edit, and delete events with title, date, and time fields
Reminder/alert toggle per event with browser Notification API support
Coral app bar and teal accent visual identity with playful owl branding
Browser-based demo runnable from GitHub Pages (no server required)
publicApiSurface: LoginActivity — username/password login against local SQLite users table
SignupActivity — create account with username and password
MainActivity — grid of event cards, FAB to add, edit/delete per card
AddEventActivity — form to insert or update an event (title, date MM/dd/yyyy, time)
SmsPermissionActivity — grant or deny SEND_SMS permission
Event model: id, title, date (MM/dd/yyyy), time, getDayOfWeek(), getDateDay()
